name: Pinned public-resource integrity verification
output_kind: verified resource manifest or fail-closed error
claim_ceiling: The bytes used by a run match the registered size and checksum.
out_of_scope: Scientific validity, repository immutability, and future availability.
notes: GN-R01 is one reference exercise, not cross-paper verification.

name: Cross-source patient identity linkage
input_modalities: bulk expression; platform annotation; clinical supplement
output_kind: one-row-per-patient source table plus unmatched-ID audit
claim_ceiling: Records from separate sources are joined completely and uniquely by an audited identifier.
out_of_scope: Biological validity of the endpoint and independence of the cohort.
notes: GN-R01 links GSE62254 expression, GPL570 annotation, and the ACRG clinical supplement.

name: Fixed bulk-expression signature reconstruction
input_modalities: bulk microarray expression; locked formula; patient outcome
output_kind: patient scores, grouping, sensitivity summary, and source tables
claim_ceiling: Retrospective calculation and association under an explicit transform, mapping, and cutoff.
out_of_scope: Untouched external validation, individual deployment, other modalities, and universal biological direction.
notes: GN-R01 is the sole reference exercise; no transfer case is registered.
